claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Efest IMR 18650 2250mAh 10A as a 2250mAh preset with a 10A runtime rating.

Historical records identify Panasonic-labelled Efest IMR 18650 2250mAh variants in both button-top and flat-top forms; the entries are unprotected and the underlying cell is not independently established for this catalog record.

The Efest IMR 18650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
No reliable exact-model market-introduction date was established for Efest IMR 18650 in the 2026-08-04 catalog-wide research pass.
